chunks: With this chain, from al-Hasan, from Abu Ayyub al-Kazzaz, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Abdillah and Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:
Whoever recites the Surah of 'At-Tur', Allah will gather for him the goodness of this world and the Hereafter.

key_terms.وَ الطُّورِ: Wa al-Tur (The Mount, referring to Surah At-Tur)

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for reciting Surah At-Tur according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq in *Thawab al-A'mal*, this hadith emphasizes the spiritual and material benefits of reciting Surah At-Tur, linking the reciter to the Imams through a chain including al-Hasan and Abu Ayyub al-Kazzaz. It promises that the reciter will be granted comprehensive goodness encompassing both worldly affairs and the afterlife, reflecting the Shia belief in the intercessory and transformative power of Quranic recitation. This reward underscores the holistic nature of divine favor, where spiritual devotion yields tangible benefits in both dunya and akhira.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1.  It  is  narrated  from  Imam  Ja’far  Sadiq  (a.s.)  that  Imam Muhammad Baqir (a.s.) said, “
To one who recites Surah Tur Allah would grant goodness in this world and the hereafter.”
